verdict.rationale: The docs make a quantified relative claim that Milvus delivers 30%-70% better performance than FAISS and HNSWLib, plus scale claims of billions to tens of billions of vectors. No published benchmark report, latency figures, or recall numbers appear in the evidence. The only community throughput figure (thousands of QPS on billions of vectors) comes from a self-described possibly biased Milvus team member. Missing for 10: a published benchmark suite with methodology, measured latency (p50/p99) numbers, recall-vs-throughput figures, and independent reproduction of the performance claims.
